goal: Hán–Nôm script, reading, romanization, and translation review.
summary: Implemented and verified the Hán–Nôm script, reading, romanization, and translation review domain layer for Cửu Đỉnh heritage epigraphy. Established explicit separation of script glyphs (Hán–Nôm Unicode CJK ideographs), Sino-Vietnamese readings (phiên âm Hán-Việt), modern Vietnamese meanings, and English translations. Enforced negative abuse protections preventing AI-guessed, machine OCR candidates, or unreviewed seed glyphs from being promoted to verified without human epigrapher sign-off. Built audit and tracking for the 4 known incomplete motifs (urn_nghi_dinh_03, urn_thuan_dinh_13, urn_tuyen_dinh_11, urn_huyen_dinh_12) ensuring they remain strictly tracked as missing / pending epigrapher review, and integrated governance guards into the historical claims state machine for translation and etymology claim transitions.
invariants_enforced: SEPARATION_OF_EPIGRAPHIC_ATTRIBUTES: Script glyphs, Sino-Vietnamese readings, modern Vietnamese meanings, and English translations are tracked as separate, typed fields with controlled review statuses.

NEGATIVE_ABUSE_AI_GUESS_PROMOTION_BLOCKED: AI-generated, AI OCR candidate, or unverified seed glyphs MUST NEVER be marked verified without a qualified human epigrapher sign-off (raises UnverifiedPromotionForbiddenError).
EMPTY_GLYPH_VERIFICATION_REJECTED: Empty or missing glyphs cannot be promoted to verified (raises HanNomReviewError).

MISSING_GLYPH_TRACKING_PARITY: The 4 known incomplete motifs from W00 baseline (urn_nghi_dinh_03, urn_thuan_dinh_13, urn_tuyen_dinh_11, urn_huyen_dinh_12) are explicitly identified and tracked as missing/pending review across all 9 Urn data files.
UNCERTAIN_READING_PRESERVATION: Ambiguous, homophonic, or damaged inscription readings are strictly preserved with uncertainty flags and provisional status, preventing false epigraphic certainty.
HISTORICAL_CLAIM_TRANSLATION_GATE: Historical governance claim state machine blocks transitioning AI-generated translation/etymology claims to expert_verified unless verified by human epigraphers.

audit_findings_162_motifs.seed_glyphs_classification: All 158 raw seed glyphs are classified as provisional / AI draft; zero are auto-promoted to verified.

changes.description: Created domain module implementing HanNomReviewStatus, HanNomProvenanceOrigin, HanNomMotifReviewRecord, HanNomReviewInput, KNOWN_MISSING_HAN_NOM_MOTIF_IDS, validate_han_nom_promotion, and audit_162_han_nom_dataset.
Re-exported Hán–Nôm review domain symbols, models, exceptions, and validators for seamless use across backend models and services.

Added guardrail in transition_claim_status to reject promoting translation and etymology claims to expert_verified if origin is AI-generated without human epigrapher review or if confidence is uncertain/disputed.

Created 8 comprehensive pytest tests covering epigraphic attribute separation, negative abuse rejection of AI guesses and missing glyphs, 4 known incomplete motifs tracking, preservation of uncertain readings, valid epigrapher promotion with provenance, governance translation claim transition blocking, and audit of all 158 seed motifs.

test_details.name: test_han_nom_data_structure_and_epigraphic_attributes

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_guessed_glyph_cannot_be_verified

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_empty_or_missing_glyph_cannot_be_verified
test_details.assertion: Asserts promoting None or blank whitespace glyphs to human_verified raises HanNomReviewError.

test_details.name: test_four_known_incomplete_motifs_tracked_as_missing_and_pending_review
test_details.assertion: Asserts audit_162_han_nom_dataset identifies exactly 4 missing motifs matching KNOWN_MISSING_HAN_NOM_MOTIF_IDS and tracks them as missing.

test_details.name: test_uncertain_and_provisional_readings_flagged_and_preserved
test_details.assertion: Asserts provisional candidates and uncertain readings retain uncertainty flags and notes without false promotion.

test_details.name: test_valid_epigrapher_promotion_passes_with_provenance
test_details.assertion: Asserts valid epigrapher signoff with provenance successfully passes validation.

test_details.name: test_historical_claim_translation_epigraphic_guardrail

test_details.name: test_all_158_seed_motifs_treated_as_provisional_ai_draft
test_details.assertion: Asserts all 158 raw seed motifs with glyphs are classified as provisional and AI-guessed, with zero auto-promoted to human_verified.

test_details.name: test_structured_han_nom_review_schema_and_fields
test_details.assertion: Asserts structured Hán-Nôm review schema implements required fields, properties, aliases, and controlled statuses.

test_details.name: test_verified_motifs_require_valid_readings_and_translations

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_guessing_glyph_without_source_citation_blocked
test_details.assertion: Asserts guessing glyph without source citation or with dummy citations is blocked or flagged.

test_details.name: test_four_unconfirmed_motifs_marked_uncertain_or_unreviewed

test_details.name: test_heritage_import_validate_han_nom_reviews_integration
